name: Kitchen sink (LuatOS ESP32C3-CORE)

reserved.11: Powers the flash chip (VDD_SPI). It only becomes a GPIO after a one-way eFuse burn.

notes: A LuatOS ESP32C3-CORE (classic version, CH343 USB-serial chip on GPIO 20 and 21) with a potentiometer on GPIO 0, a push button to GND on GPIO 3 and one WS2812 on GPIO 6. The board's own LEDs are D4 on GPIO 12 and D5 on GPIO 13, and BOOT is GPIO 9. Pick it by hand. Wiring: the Kitchen-sink board page in the user guide.
